distinction_from_mainnet.warning: Devnet USDC is a test faucet token with arbitrary supply; never treat devnet tokens as genuine monetary value.

simulation_preflight.purpose: Enables pre-broadcast error detection, compute-unit estimation, and account state simulation without spending SOL or signing keys.

blockhash_lifetime.rule: Every Solana transaction embeds a recentBlockhash. If a transaction is not confirmed within 150 slots, it is permanently expired by validators.

duplicate_prevention.rule: Re-broadcasting a transaction with the same signature and valid blockhash returns an idempotent confirmation or 'AlreadyProcessed' status. It CANNOT execute twice.

commitment_levels.processed: Transaction observed by current leader (fastest, unconfirmed).
commitment_levels.confirmed: Voted by supermajority (2/3+ of stake). Suitable for UI progress feedback.
commitment_levels.finalized: Rooted in cluster ledger (31+ confirmed blocks on top). Irrevocable. AGUS settlement requirement.

error_taxonomy.InstructionError: Smart contract logic rejected execution (e.g. SPL Token insufficient funds, unauthorized freeze).
error_taxonomy.BlockhashNotFound: Transaction submitted with an expired or invalid recent blockhash.
error_taxonomy.InsufficientFundsForFee: Payer wallet has fewer lamports than required for network base fee + priority fee.
